sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy

Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the purpose of signals and the red and yellow light rules resolve to the first selected page, the green light and lighted arrows to the second, combination, flashing and lane control signals to the third, and the remaining lane control and pedestrian signals to the fourth.

Confidence: high across the section; every indication is described in printed text beside its picture, and the statements restate the printed text, not the pictures.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the standard three-color signals, turns on red, lighted arrows, combination signals, flashing signals, lane control signals and pedestrian signals rules on pages 39–42 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
